sections.text_helper: Section 72.2.5 "ID management" in chapter 72 (USB subsystem (USBSS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3751.
sections.section_content:
If IDPULLUP_DIS control bit in OTG_GCCFG register is 0, the ID information is captured on
OTG1_ID pin and provided by the OTGPHY1 to the OTG1 controller. If the OTG1_ID pin is
unused and left floating, PULLDOWN_EN bit in the OTG_GCCFG register of OTG1 can be
used to control the pull-down resistors on OTG1_HSDP and OTG1_HSDM pins.
